articles.title: Preds Fathers' Trip Provides Chance for Players to Reflect, Give Thanks to Dads
Preds Official Podcast: The Hall of Famer's Coach
GAME DAY: Preds at Avalanche, November 5
Projected Lineup: Nov. 5 at New Jersey

out.detail: right hand injury; remains on injured reserve after conditioning assignment

away.summary: The Blues (7-7-2) are on a four-game road trip and could use the same lineup from their 5-4 overtime loss at New Jersey on Thursday. Projected goalie Jordan Binnington is listed first in the projected lineup. Scratches are Jonatan Berggren and Theo Lindstein, while Tyler Tucker, Dillon Dube, and Logan Mailloux are injured.

out.detail: lower-body injury; expected to miss a third straight game

home.summary: The Predators (7-4-5) could go with the same lineup from their 3-2 overtime win at Colorado on Thursday. Juuse Saros is listed first among projected goalies. Nicolas Hague and Ilya Lyubushkin are scratched, while Jonathan Marchessault (lower body, day-to-day) and William Trudeau (upper body) are injured.
